description: Portable development and runtime support pack for AI agents working on or inside Decky AI Assistant.
conflict_rules: AGENTS.md is canonical for repo development instructions.
Use the deck-project-developer skill for repo-local implementation slices; runtime roles are explicit handoff boundaries, not the default editor.
Portable skills own shared behavior; target adapters only wrap or package it.
Runtime roles are organizational labels; requested fixes stay under the active CLI's own controls.
One repo development slice has one active owner and one meaningful commit.
Development handoffs must include scope, files changed, verification, risk notes, commit status, and next owner.
Risk metadata must be visible while user-requested writes stay in the active CLI workflow.
Requested fixes run through the active CLI shell/tooling; Decky does not execute those fixes separately.
